Atiq Ahmed's Son Aban Dies in Highway Accident

Atiq Ahmed's son Aban died in a highway accident in Uttar Pradesh's Jhansi district on Thursday. The car collided with a divider, causing significant damage to the vehicle. Three people were killed and three others injured in the accident. Aban was on his way to meet his brother Ali Ahmed at the jail.
